title: Derive the fixed paid and target residuals of the 17-stage caller
body:
This independent accounting proof derives both fixed residuals of the exact 17-stage caller: `P = 17 H_native + K` and `T = 17 T_native + K_T`. The constants come from literal caller operations and declared output owners. They are not obtained by subtracting a native histogram from a published invoice. **The complete kappa calculation and selected frontier do not change.**

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1e6fd08a7c4fb616ea802c5f432f58594d14a107/research/caller-8x9-derived-residuals/PROOF.md), [checked result](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1e6fd08a7c4fb616ea802c5f432f58594d14a107/research/caller-8x9-derived-residuals/RESULT.json), [verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1e6fd08a7c4fb616ea802c5f432f58594d14a107/research/caller-8x9-derived-residuals/verify.py), and [exact copied source inventory](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1e6fd08a7c4fb616ea802c5f432f58594d14a107/research/caller-8x9-derived-residuals/VENDORED.json).

The result closes the fixed-caller accounting gap in [fluorine's handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19664352), following [PR #7628](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7628) at `6db8d8351a2bb5a530500303fb6b848b50841926` and [PR #7639](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7639) at `6f4ef058b2c15a4e7245c4dafb978d969221be37`. Those audits measure the residuals. Their code is not imported.

The caller contributes 3,776 paid positions and 3,744 distinct declared root targets. The paid residual includes 384 rank-one query positions and 32 signed rank-nine idle positions. After these terms are derived, an independent binary-rank census of the copied native word gives the complete source invoice: 110,638 paid positions and 22,172 productive fields. Every histogram entry agrees. All 4,783 caller events and the 17 ordered native invocations are inspected.

The base is `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The consumed caller and native bytes are from [PR #7113](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7113), at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`; see its [caller](https://github.com/rohanarun/integer-mult-bounds/blob/07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d/research/signed-caller-8x9/expected/ODD-TYPE-AB-CALLER.json). Exact copies, Git blob IDs, SHA256 hashes, licenses and notices are retained in this package. No pending source head is needed in publication ancestry.

Use Python 3.12 and its standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/caller-8x9-derived-residuals
```

Expected output includes:

```text
PASS_CALLER_DERIVED_RESIDUALS
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE
```

Local normal and optimized isolated replay passed. Nine semantic controls cover omitted queries, the signed-idle query axis, changed output rank, duplicate ports, missing outputs, aliased native owners, stage order, repeated idle blocks and a wrong idle sign. Committed bytes, source ancestry and the official export checks passed. An optimized replay of the exported package passed with no Git executable, read-only files and unchanged file hashes. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44230689917/job/134554692948) failed in `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the shared main CI guide still names `frontier6030`, while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped. The package replay job was skipped. The package changes no shared CI file; the local verification above remains the evidence for this result.

This proof uses the declared output diagonals and the stated operation interfaces. It does not independently establish the 72 caller endpoints, native operators or chronology, owned erasure legality, physical binding, ordinary cost, precision, compiler, BIT branch or outer reduction. Those checks and the full selected cold replay were not run. The five inherited assumptions remain `native_all_columns`, `owned_erasure`, `compiler`, `precision_tape` and `analytic_recovery`. A successor must preserve the exact caller and native contact interface before it can reuse these constants. No supplier admission is claimed.

Rohan Arun (@rohanarun) supplied the caller and native package; his [source credit](https://github.com/rohanarun/integer-mult-bounds/blob/07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d/research/signed-caller-8x9/README.md) records the DreamingOfClouds, CubeJerry, ToikY, dillona and Ali Romman lineage. The [retained notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1e6fd08a7c4fb616ea802c5f432f58594d14a107/research/caller-8x9-derived-residuals/source/NOTICE) and [independent notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1e6fd08a7c4fb616ea802c5f432f58594d14a107/research/caller-8x9-derived-residuals/source/INDEPENDENT-NOTICE.md) preserve the source-specific credits. @fluorine supplied the independent recounts and this handoff. Ali Romman directed the new proof, verifier and documentation with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. New work is Apache-2.0.
